newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to reveal phone tender winners Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Israel to reveal phone tender winners Wednesday.

text.p: Israel's Communications Ministry on Wednesday will announce the winners of two licences to provide international phone service in competition with Bezeq Israel Telecom, a ministry spokeswoman said.
The announcement will be made in Jerusalem at 1330 local time (1030 GMT).
Six consortia made up of Israeli and multinational companies have submitted bids in the tender.

Among international companies competing for the licence are Sprint, Deutsche Telecom, France Telecom, Southwestern Bell, British Telecom, Bellsouth, MCI Communications, Bell Atlantic, Korea Telecom and Italy's STET.
State-controlled Bezeq currently has a monopoly on international services from Israel. One third of its revenue and nearly half of its profits are from its international services.
Ministry officials have predicted that prices of foreign calls will drop by as much as 60 percent once competition begins.
